extracted text: The synthesis of ITQ-37 zeolite uses SDA2 as the structure directing agent. SDA2 is a bulky diquaternary ammonium molecule with four chiral centers in a meso conformation, making the overall molecule achiral. Synthesis gels were prepared using an automated system. GeO2 and boric acid or alumina were dissolved in the structure directing agent hydroxide solution. Then colloidal silica was added, and finally, a solution of NH4F. The synthesis gel was transferred to Teflon vials, which were inserted in a 15-well multiautoclave. Crystallization was carried out at 175°C under static conditions. The chemical formula of ITQ-37 is |(C22N2H40)10.5(H2O)x|[Ge80Si112O400H32F20].
